question: What is the maximum dilutive impact in number of shares of Snapchat's outstanding convertible notes as of 12/31/2024?
answer: 85,945,127 shares if all converts were converted (including out of the money converts)

model_answer:
**About 85.9 million shares** (85,945 thousand) of Class A common stock. That is the maximum dilutive impact of Snap's convertible notes as of December 31, 2024.

Snap's FY2024 10-K reports this as the "Convertible Notes (if-converted)" figure. It was excluded from diluted EPS because it was anti-dilutive. For comparison, the figure was 89,379 thousand shares at year-end 2023.

The figure covers the 2025, 2026, 2027, 2028 and 2030 convertible notes, all converted at their stated conversion rates. It doesn't include extra shares that could be issued if the conversion rate were increased after a make-whole fundamental change. The filing doesn't quantify those extra shares.

Snap can also settle conversions in cash or a mix of cash and shares, so 85.9 million is the share-settled ceiling rather than an expected issuance.

Source: Snap Inc. Form 10-K for FY2024, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1564408/000156440825000019/snap-20241231.htm
